The '''Drearia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
The Drearia system was the location of the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]].
